mechanism_narrative: A sustained 4-month decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing demand, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average and remains below for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in INDPRO decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market slack that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as valuation multiples contract.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in UNRATE rise periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment reacts to policy expectations.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS rise periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month rise in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above its 6-month moving average signals residential construction expansion that boosts industrial demand and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market anticipates economic growth.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above its 6-month moving average and remains above for 1 month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in HOUST rise periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Producer Price Index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening inflationary pressures that reduce cost-push inflation expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as valuation multiples expand.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below its 12-month moving average and remains below for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in INDPRO decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the Payroll Employment Index (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals labor market strength that boosts corporate earnings growth expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation multiples expand.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises above its 12-month moving average and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in PAYEMS rise periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month decline in the Retail Sales Index (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment reacts to economic growth concerns.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls below its 6-month moving average and remains below for 1 month
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC exceeds 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in RSAFS decline periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals inflationary pressures that increase discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as valuation multiples contract.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% and remains above for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL rise periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
